_comment: SPA routing for Static Web Apps. Vite copies this file from public/ into
dist/, which is where Static Web Apps looks for it.
navigationFallback serves index.html for any path that is not a real file,
so refreshing /driver/login loads the app and React Router routes it,
instead of Static Web Apps returning 404 for a file that does not exist.
The exclude list is the important half. Without it a missing or renamed
asset also returns index.html with status 200, and the browser tries to
parse HTML as JavaScript: 'Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token <'. That
is far harder to diagnose than an honest 404.
Do NOT add a responseOverrides 404 rewrite alongside this. It catches the
404s that exclude deliberately produces and turns them back into index.html
with status 200, which silently defeats the whole exclude list. Verified in
production: with that override present, /assets/does-not-exist.js returned
200 text/html; with it removed it returns 404.
